sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head, thorax and abdomen brownish black, the middle of the thoracic tergites and abdominal tergites 5—8 paler; postclypeus distinctly paler than the head, clay-coloured; labrum, antennae, legs, pleura and sternites slightly paler than the postclypeus; wings pale smoky brown. Overall similar to M. leai but distinctly smaller: head slightly less red, with more hairs, compound eyes slightly larger, antennae, mouthparts, legs and venter distinctly paler, pronotum paler, smaller and differently shaped, wings about equal in length but distinctly wider and darker, and the arrangement of the spinules on the wing membrane also different. Antenna 14-segmented, segment 1 twice as long as wide, segment 2 large, its length equal to the width of segment 1, segment 3 extremely short and narrow, segment 4 short and wide, as wide as segment 2, segment 5 distinctly larger than segment 4. Pronotum with the anterior margin nearly straight and slightly concave in the middle, the anterior margin raised, the anterolateral corners and the sides rounded, the posterior margin wavy, the whole surface with long and short setae; the posterior margin of the meso- and metanotum distinctly wavy. Wings short and wide, the radius, radial sector and media dark very near the apex, as are the first 5—6 branches of the cubitus, the radial sector with numerous medium-length setae along its whole length, the media of the hind wing arising from the radial sector far beyond the suture, the wing membrane with scattered setae and densely covered with distinct spinules. Measurements: head length (to the tip of the labium) 0.85, head length (to the frontoclypeal suture) 0.51, head width 0.74, compound eye diameter 0.28 transversely, 0.22 longitudinally, pronotum length 0.40, width 0.54, wing length 10.6—11.25, hind tibia length 0.62 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head, together with the legs and antennae, ochraceous yellowish brown, the thorax, legs and antennae paler. Head long and narrow, the sides parallel, broadly rounded behind, with only very few very short setae; anteclypeus short and wide, the anterior margin arched; labrum large, slightly wider than long, the sides parallel, the apex broadly rounded, with a group of medium-sized setae in the middle of the apical 1/4; mandibles short and very stout, curved and toothed; antenna 13-segmented, about as long as the mandibles, segment 3 the smallest, segments 4 and 5 nearly equal, segments 6—13 gradually longer, segment 13 narrow and as long as segment 1; postmentum wide, its narrowest part about 1/4 of the head width. Pronotum small, with few setae, mostly marginal, a few very long near the lateral corners, narrowed and raised in the anterior 1/4, deeply concave in the middle, the anterolateral corners projecting, the sides nearly straight, the posterior margin broadly truncate to slightly wavy. Meso- and metanotum with a fringe of sparse long setae. Measurements: head length including mandibles 1.99—2.10, length without mandibles 1.30—1.42, head width 0.774, narrowest width of the postmentum 0.20, mandible length (from the outer articulation) 0.68—0.74, antennal length 1.02, pronotum length 0.23, width 0.52 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head pale yellowish brown, frons, antennae, thorax and legs milky white, with a dark red spot at the mandibular articulation. Head with moderate hairs, mostly short, the sides parallel, broadly rounded behind, widest at the level of the antennal sockets; postclypeus large and raised, distinctly rounded behind, truncate in front, with a clear median suture and about 12 red setae; anteclypeus large, projecting in the middle of the anterior margin; labrum medium-sized, raised, narrowed at the base, the sides raised to a rounded apex, with about 8 short thick hairs near the apex; antenna 13-segmented, the segmentation as in the alate. Pronotum as in the soldier but with fewer hairs; the posterior margin of the meso- and metanotum broadly rounded to nearly truncate. Abdomen long and narrow, sparsely and faintly hairy, cerci large.

note: Adapted from the original description by Hill (1927), original in English; it includes the alate, the soldier and the worker. The measurement table of the original is damaged in the scan, and only legible values that are mutually consistent have been taken (the soldier head length including mandibles was checked by adding the length without mandibles and the mandible length); the worker measurements are illegible and are therefore not entered.
